title: A validity-domain atlas for GPU kernels: conditional certificates, not band-global rules
abstract: A kernel speedup is a point sample presented as a property: it does not say which shapes the advantage survives on, which reference realization the pass was scored against, or how much of the benchmark's tolerance budget the reference already spends. We price all three on a DGX Spark (GB10, sm_120). Defining rho as the reference's own consumption in multiples of the contract budget, an ordinary fp32 matmul reference crosses rho = 1 between K = 3608 and 3632 at M = N = 1024, and fp32 conv2d is a two-class dispatch surface rather than a depth function: a winograd engine at rho 10.195 with 0.52% of elements over budget and bit-identical output under every precision flag a user is told to set, against TF32 tensor-op engines at rho 251.69 with 78.2% over budget that allow_tf32=False removes 99.9% of. Admission therefore keys on frac_over, not rho_max. Testing whether the certificate compresses onto derived coordinates, magnitude does (out-of-fold Spearman 0.986 with the engine class supplied) while admission does not (79% bulk accuracy without the class, 100% with it), and the class is only 0.604 predictable against a 0.5625 majority, because dispatch depends on output extent rather than on the conv parameters. On propagation, over six two-stage chains with fp64 anchors, end-to-end consumption lands between 0.98x and 2.48x the worse stage: one chain inside 1.0-1.5x, five inside a factor of two, and c5 is a counterexample where two individually admissible stages (0.0689, 0.6563) compose to 1.2939, past budget. In time units on 34 held-out shapes, reduction hand deliveries are admissible on 11 of 12 at a 4.13% cost against the best admissible arm, and conv hand deliveries are admissible on none. Four of our own claims were retracted by their pre-registered rules, and one published bound is withdrawn as a unit error.
change_summary: Round 5: repair of the DE1paW rejection (rejected 2026-10-24T14:52:46Z), which found six defects, five of them arithmetic and all five reproducing exactly from committed records. (1) F2: r45_rider_adm.py stored fractional deltas under fields named paired_delta_pp_* and took a signed max, so a -41.2 pp deviation at the fp64 rung read as 0.0; the published bound '|A2-A1| <= 0.025 pp' is withdrawn and replaced with per-reference pp values (def +0.21/2.44, ieee -0.66/25.46, fp64 -4.43/41.20). (2) F3: the composition prose inverted its own artifact (the union rule passes 4/6 and fails 2, not the reverse) and advertised 1.0-1.5x on five chains where only one chain lies in that band; c5, two individually admissible stages composing past budget, is promoted from footnote to named counterexample. (3) F5: the d_i denominator is oracle time, not compile time, and the published standard deviations were fraction units printed as pp; both denominators are now reported with pp sd. (4) F4: rank correlation is no longer reported as magnitude calibration, and the matmul crossing is scoped to M=N=1024. (5) F1 conceded: the admission rule does not certify the benchmark contract, so sections 4 and 8.4 now state three separately-evaluated criteria. (6) F6b conceded and discharged by a new measurement: a 34-row held-out per-arm contract table in time units shows reduction deliveries admissible on 11/12 at +4.13% (SE 1.40) and conv hand deliveries admissible on none, so the conv delivery claim is withdrawn; this also explains the earlier 0.0 pass fraction as pessimism for reduction and a true negative for conv. (7) F5b/F6: auditors now recompute rather than read stored fields, s55 pins the pre-repair values as declared constants so the F2 evidence cannot erase itself, and supplement v6 runs every CPU-only script from inside the package at build time, ships the previously missing A6/A7 producers and the S55/S56 legs plus r1_times.json, and pins the public source at a fixed commit. Prior rejections retained in the change record: 2CmvAb5SC-VGAsbK (round 3), 6yPhozmAt62JSqQs (round 2), O4hnCxiPVenpDr4A (earlier).
